Title: Public Works Office
Description: Pool scrap at the Public Works clerk to keep the island's utilities running — power, water, gas, markets, airport, internet, trains and heli protection. When something breaks, take the repair contract and get paid.

Commands.Description: Open the services panel (at the office)
Drink from your inventory, or list drinks

HowTo: Type /pwinfo anywhere to see which services are running and what's broken.
Walk to the Public Works clerk (orange dot on your map) and type /pw.
Click a service to pay scrap into its shared bucket — the whole island benefits.
If a service breaks, hit TAKE JOB, bring the listed materials to the red map dot, and press USE at the site for a scrap reward.
Use the grocery machines, drone delivery and gas-station pumps while those services are paid up.
Thirsty? Buy a Mr Spice or vodka at the grocery, put it on your belt, holster your hands and right-click to swig — or just type /drink.
Notes: Services cost about 100 scrap per day and drain faster with more players online.
Banked time is shared by the whole server.
Repair contracts are first come, first paid.
